newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka tenders for 100,000 tonnes of wheat.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders for 100,000 tonnes of wheat.

text.p: Sri Lanka on Wednesday announced a tender for 50,000 tonnes each of hard and soft wheat, according to an official of the state buying arm Cooperative Wholesale Establishment.
The tender will close on March 13, the official told Reuters.
He said delivery for the 50,000 tonnes of soft wheat, if of U.S. origin, was set for between March 31 and April 9, and if of Australian origin between April 14-23.
Delivery for 50,000 tonnes of hard wheat for the first category was scheduled for between April 21-30 and for the second variety between May 5-14, the official said.
